newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens gets Philippine energy contract.
newsitem.headline: Siemens gets Philippine energy contract.

text.p: German industrial giant Siemens AG said on Monday its energy transmission unit (EV) had won contracts worth 126 million marks ($79.6 million) to expand an electric power network in the Philippines.
EV signed contracts with the National Power Corporation to build control, communication and switching stations for the Luzon energy projects in the northwest islands of the Philippines.
The system is scheduled to go on line by the end of 1998 and would deliver electric power to areas near the city of Manila, Siemens said.
The new system would increase the network's capacity to 500 kilovolts, up from the 230 kilovolts carried by the country's existing power systems.
